scoring_justification: Agent's CSV values compared to paper-reported gold; trends also verified. Cannot recompute from raw simulation data (not present).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold thermal conductivity values from paper Figures 5 and 7
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's Fig.5(a) and Fig.7(a) as numerical data; extracted from the paper text (sections 3.1 and 3.2).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from paper's reported values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are exact numbers reported in the paper's text; no fabrication.

outputs.description: Tabulated thermal conductivity of double-walled carbon nanotubes (DWCNT) under varying length, temperature, and interlayer twist angle. The hidden checker compares each row's thermal_conductivity_W_mK value against paper-reported gold values within a hidden tolerance, and also verifies required monotonic trends for DWCNT (k increases with ITCA, increases with length, decreases with temperature).

output_contract.notes: The scored CSV contains only DWCNT rows: length series, temperature series, and twist-angle series. The hidden verifier checks all DWCNT conditions.
